name: breakaway
description: A task board for you and your coding agents: they claim the work, you merge it. The tasks skill, /breakaway:claim, /breakaway:next, /breakaway:hand-over, and the session hooks that show an agent's output on its task.

board_url.title: Board address
board_url.description: Your board's address, like https://board.example.com. A BREAKAWAY_URL, npx breakaway setup, or a checkout's .taskrc still comes first.

token.title: Token
token.description: Your board's token. Claude Code keeps it in your system keychain. A BREAKAWAY_TOKEN or npx breakaway setup still comes first.

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: The name your sessions claim tasks with. Leave it empty to use claude-<branch>.
